This overdrive emulates the the expansive midrange and strident cascading gain stages of the D*lightful amplifier this pedal is based on.  When you turn it on, it will unleash your guitar's full-throated potential with an articulate attack and smooth sustain that's reminiscent of players like Robben Ford and Larry Carlton. If you're a tone chaser, the Ultraphonix MKII Specialized Overdrive pedal will help you achieve the D-style tone you've been dreaming of that doesn’t require a mortgage to purchase! BASED ON "REAL DEAL" SIX-FIGURE AMPLIFIERS The R&D for the Ultraphonix pedal took over four (4) years, and almost a half-dozen of these uber-rare six-figure amplifiers!  From 2012 to 2016, we got ahold of five (5) of this particular model amplifier to most accurately voice the Ultraphonix pedal, comparing to the "real deal" - many of these amps were owned and/or used by world-famous users.  Knowing that these amps were customized to the player, our goal was to find the "X Factor" among a variety of amps and distill the "D-Style" essence into the most authentic sounding and feeling "amp in a box" pedal - and we NAILED IT!
